description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office of Member of the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a member who ceased to be a party member, including the nomination process by a political party secretary and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under election-related matters, specifically candidate nominations and declarations for local authority elections.
